title: Identifying magnetic phases in chemically ordered and disordered FeAl thin films
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,36763-36770
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06100D, Paper
Open Access

A. Zarzycki, M. S. Anwar, R. Bali, K. Potzger, M. Krupinski, M. Marszalek
Ferromagnetic (FM) and spin-glass (SG) phases coexist in spatially modulated chemically disordered Fe60Al40 thin films. Low-temperature magnetic interactions vary from uncoupled to exchange-spring behavior, depending on phase composition.
